question: How many final rules (not proposed rules) are in the warehouse?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_RULE f JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_RULE r ON r.rule_key = f.rule_key WHERE r.document_type = 'Rule'

question: How many proposed rules were published in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_RULE f JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_RULE r ON r.rule_key = f.rule_key JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_DATE d ON d.date_key = f.publication_date_key WHERE r.document_type = 'Proposed Rule' AND d.year = 2025

question: Which 5 agencies are the primary agency on the most rules?
gold_sql: SELECT a.agency_name FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_RULE f JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_AGENCY a ON a.agency_key = f.primary_agency_key GROUP BY a.agency_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many rules are open for public comment?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_RULE WHERE is_open_for_comment

question: What is the average comment period, in days, for proposed rules?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(f.comment_period_days), 1) FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_RULE f JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_RULE r ON r.rule_key = f.rule_key WHERE r.document_type = 'Proposed Rule' AND f.comment_period_days IS NOT NULL

question: How many different rules affect restaurants (NAICS 722) or retailers (NAICS 44-45)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bi.rule_key) FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.BRIDGE_RULE_INDUSTRY bi JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_INDUSTRY i ON i.industry_key = bi.industry_key WHERE i.naics_code IN ('722', '44-45')

question: How many different rules affecting construction (NAICS 23) were published in 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.rule_key) FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_RULE f JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_DATE d ON d.date_key = f.publication_date_key JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.BRIDGE_RULE_INDUSTRY bi ON bi.rule_key = f.rule_key JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_INDUSTRY i ON i.industry_key = bi.industry_key WHERE i.naics_code = '23' AND d.year = 2026

question: Which Boston neighborhood has the most food establishments?
gold_sql: SELECT n.neighborhood_name FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_NEIGHBORHOOD_PROFILE p JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_NEIGHBORHOOD n ON n.neighborhood_key = p.neighborhood_key ORDER BY p.food_establishment_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many food establishments are in Fenway?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_ESTABLISHMENT e JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_NEIGHBORHOOD n ON n.neighborhood_key = e.neighborhood_key WHERE n.neighborhood_name = 'Fenway'

question: How many residents live in Jamaica Plain?
gold_sql: SELECT p.residents FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_NEIGHBORHOOD_PROFILE p JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_NEIGHBORHOOD n ON n.neighborhood_key = p.neighborhood_key WHERE n.neighborhood_name = 'Jamaica Plain'

question: According to Census business counts, how many cafes and snack bars are in ZIP code 02130?
gold_sql: SELECT b.establishments FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_BUSINESS_COUNT b JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_ZIP z ON z.zip_key = b.zip_key JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_INDUSTRY i ON i.industry_key = b.industry_key WHERE z.zip_code = '02130' AND i.naics_code = '722515'

question: How many substantive changes have been made to the OSHA construction safety rules (29 CFR 1926)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_CFR_CHANGE f JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_CFR_PART p ON p.cfr_part_key = f.cfr_part_key WHERE p.cfr_citation = '29 CFR 1926' AND f.is_substantive

question: On what date did the version of 21 CFR 117 that was in force on March 1, 2025 start?
gold_sql: SELECT valid_from FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_CFR_PART WHERE cfr_citation = '21 CFR 117' AND '2025-03-01'::DATE BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to

question: How many versions of 29 CFR 1926 are stored?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_CFR_PART WHERE cfr_citation = '29 CFR 1926'

question: How many rules took effect in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_RULE f JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_DATE d ON d.date_key = f.effective_date_key WHERE d.year = 2025

question: How many rules have no effective date recorded?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_RULE WHERE effective_date_key = -1

question: How many bills are flagged as relevant to small businesses?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_BILL WHERE is_small_business_relevant

question: In which month of 2025 were the most rules published?
gold_sql: SELECT d.month_name FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_RULE f JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_DATE d ON d.date_key = f.publication_date_key WHERE d.year = 2025 GROUP BY d.month_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many rules were issued jointly by more than one agency?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_RULE WHERE agency_count > 1

question: How many rules did the Environmental Protection Agency publish as primary agency in 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_RULE f JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_AGENCY a ON a.agency_key = f.primary_agency_key JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_DATE d ON d.date_key = f.publication_date_key WHERE a.agency_name = 'Environmental Protection Agency' AND d.year = 2024

question: How many food establishments are outside Boston's neighborhoods?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_ESTABLISHMENT WHERE neighborhood_key = -1

question: How many students are enrolled at colleges located in Fenway?
gold_sql: SELECT p.students_nearby FROM REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.FACT_NEIGHBORHOOD_PROFILE p JOIN REGRADAR_DB.GOLD.DIM_NEIGHBORHOOD n ON n.neighborhood_key = p.neighborhood_key WHERE n.neighborhood_name = 'Fenway'
